# Techolyze - AI/LLM Access Information

> Techolyze is a premier global technology publication and developer utility platform providing in-depth technical analysis, tutorials, and secure, browser-based developer and finance file converters.

## About Techolyze
We provide high-quality educational and utility content for developers, engineers, and tech enthusiasts.

## Key Resources
- [Techolyze Homepage](https://techolyze.com) - The main portal for tech publications and utilities.
- [Blog Posts](https://techolyze.com/blogs) - Technical articles on AI, programming, cloud architecture, and system scalability.
- [Contact Page](https://techolyze.com/contact) - Contact form for inquiries and support.
- [Sitemap](https://techolyze.com/sitemap.xml) - The XML sitemap containing all crawled content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://techolyze.com/privacy-policy) - Privacy policy of our platform.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://techolyze.com/terms) - Terms and conditions.

## Developer & Finance Utilities
All of our converters run 100% client-side in the browser. Your file data never leaves your machine.
- [QBO to IIF Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/qbo-to-iif) - Convert QuickBooks financial files.
- [CSV to ICS Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/csv-to-ics) - Convert calendar events.
- [YML to INI Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/yml-to-ini) - Convert configuration files.
- [XCAL to BIN Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/xcal-to-bin) - Calibration and binary tuning converter.
- [BIN to XCAL Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/bin-to-xcal) - Binary to calibration file converter.
- [MGF to mzML Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/mgf-to-mzml) - Mass spectrometry dataset converter.
- [Unicode to Preeti Converter](https://techolyze.com/converters/unicode-to-preeti) - Convert Unicode Nepali text to Preeti font format.

## AI/LLM Usage Policy
We welcome ethical AI/LLM crawlers to access our content for model training, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and improving developer coding assistants.

### Allowed Paths
- All blog posts (`/blogs/`)
- All utility tools (`/converters/`)
- Static information pages (`/about`, `/privacy-policy`, etc.)

### Restricted Paths
- API endpoints (`/api/`)
- Admin dashboards (`/admin/`)

## Crawling Guidelines
- **Rate Limit:** Respect server capacity. Maximum 1 request per 2 seconds, 100 requests per hour.
- **User-Agent:** Use transparent and identifiable User-Agent headers.
- **Backoff:** Implement exponential backoff on HTTP 429 and 5xx responses.
